issue: बंशी मधुर अधर धरि टेरी: टेरी can be past (you held the flute to your lips and played its call) or a request, as in the verses around it (आओ, निवारो, चाखो, राखो).
our reading: A request: set the flute to your lips and play its sweet call.
alternatives: Past: holding the sweet flute to your lips you called (the cows, the gopīs).

issue: लगत-लगत: the sense of the doubled participle is not settled.
our reading: Keeping it up (the rain going on and on), Indra sought to sweep Braj away.
alternatives: As it beat on Braj; on the very point of (sweeping it away).

issue: महि से: Kṛṣṇa brought Devakī's six dead sons back from Sutala, below the earth (Bhāgavata 10.85); the line says only 'from the earth'.
our reading: From the earth (the words as they stand).
alternatives: From beneath the earth (from Sutala, Bali's realm).

issue: जीवन मुक्त भयो: Śiśupāla is slain and his soul merges into Kṛṣṇa; जीवनमुक्त as a term means 'liberated while living', which does not fit his death.
our reading: He was at once set free from life (released, and liberated).
